applies_to: Neptronic SKV evaporative (media) humidifiers with up to four modules.
summary: The SKV is a multi-module evaporative humidifier. Its controller speaks BACnet MS/TP and exposes control mode and source selection, network setpoints and readings, a network fallback timeout, and per-module (1-4) demand, state, valve, float and fault objects.
notes: The guide's W? column lists Present Value for every object, so access here is inferred: inputs read-only, values writable.
Module 2-4 objects only apply to multi-module systems.
Temperature units follow the controller's Temperature Units setting.

source.title: SKV Evaporative Humidifier BACnet User Guide

integration.summary: Set MSV 4 ControlMode to Network (or an internal mode with network sources) and write demand to AV 5, or feed room RH via MSV 3 = Network. Turn the system on with BV 116 SystemPower and keep network values fresh inside the fallback timeout (AV 38).

minimum_points.name: SystDemand
minimum_points.why: Demand from the BMS, % (when MSV 4 = Network)

minimum_points.name: AlarmRelay
minimum_points.why: Closed on any alarm but airflow cutout/service warning

minimum_points.name: NetworkFallbackAlarm
minimum_points.why: On when network values time out (AV 38)

integration.enable: BV 116 SystemPower: ON = normal operation, OFF = demand inhibited. MSV 4 ControlMode selects an analog input, internal temperature/RH control or Network.
integration.heartbeat: AV 38 NetworkFallbackTimeout (1-15 min) applies whenever at least one control input uses Network as its source; AV 39 counts down and BV 121 NetworkFallbackAlarm turns on when it expires.
integration.remote_sensors: Set MSV 3 RoomRHSource or MSV 2 RoomTempSource to Network and write the values from the BMS; MSV 5 SetpointSource = Network uses the external setpoints AV 16 (RH) and AV 17 (temperature).
setup: MS/TP MAC defaults to 000 (000-254; 128-254 are non-token-passing slaves); baud auto-detects (Auto, 9600, 19200, 38400, 76800); Max_Master 127.
Device instance defaults to 153000 and can be set from the menu or via Device Object_Identifier.
gotchas: Older (2018) guide: the W? column marks every object as Present Value, so confirm writability on site.
Faults that stop a module need a manual reset (BV 95 SystResetAlarms or the Diagnostic menu).
BV 107 RunWhileServiceAlarm decides whether modules keep running when a service alarm is due.
